correctness.rationale: For algebraically closed k of odd prime characteristic p≥5, y^p-y=x^(p+1)+a x² has one pole of order p+1 and genus p(p-1)/2; the holomorphic differential basis x^i y^j dx (i+j≤p−2) follows from valuations at infinity. The explicit Cartier expansion has source weight i+2j and output weight t=i+2j−(p−1). For a=0 every possible term includes a positive power of a^(1/p), giving zero rank. For a≠0, invertible row/column rescaling transforms each t-block into evaluation of the polynomial basis P_k(u)=∏_(h=k+1)^K(u+h) at distinct u∈{1,...,N} in F_p; its rank is min(K+1,N), K=floor(t/2), N=(p−1)/2−ceil(t/2). Summing t=0...p−3 gives rank (p²−1)/8 and hence a-number (p−1)(3p−1)/8. A separate direct modular expansion/elimination (not executing the package script) for p=5,7,11 and a=0,1,2 recovered ranks 0/3, 0/6, 0/15. The all-prime claim rests on the evaluation argument.
